##### Project general facts

Anantara Dragon Seseh Bali Resort & Residences is the first luxury beachfront resort and residences in Seseh, developed by Taryan Group and operated by the world-renowned Anantara Hotels & Resorts. Featuring an extraordinary dragon-shaped design and cocoon-style residences by acclaimed British architect John Dawes, this multi-award-winning project has been recognized as Best in Indonesia at the Real Estate Asia Awards and Asia Pacific Awards. Offering a unique investment opportunity, the property combines iconic architecture with the prestige of a global blue-chip hospitality brand.

Residents and guests enjoy an exceptional array of world-class facilities, including three infinity pools, an all-day dining restaurant, a specialty Japanese restaurant, two bars, a beach lounge, a wellness and spa centre, a fitness and yoga area, a surf school, conference and coworking spaces, shops and boutiques, underground parking, and a private helipad. Every element is designed to deliver an unforgettable luxury experience, from the opulent dragon-scale interiors to the stunning fire-and-water fountain at the reception.

Each cocoon residence is a sanctuary of inspiration, harmony, and serenity, ranging from spacious studios to larger layouts with breathtaking ocean views. Interiors feature dressing rooms, luxurious bathrooms with double washbasins and glass-enclosed showers, living areas with designer furniture, and private terraces with round baths. High-end textiles, decorative lighting, and premium finishes create a warm, organic atmosphere. Fully furnished and meticulously appointed, every residence embodies the perfect balance of natural materials, artisanal detail, and modern comfort.

##### Parking
Shared and private parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on the pristine volcanic sands of Seseh Beach, this exceptional location places residents in a serene and authentic coastal enclave, known as the quieter neighbor of bustling Canggu. The area offers a peaceful escape while remaining just a short drive from the vibrant energy of Canggu’s world-famous beach clubs, restaurants, and boutiques. With stunning ocean views, dramatic sunsets, and a rich cultural landscape, Seseh is one of Bali’s most authentic and unspoiled destinations.

The location is distinguished by its prime beachfront positioning and strong growth trajectory. As the only oceanfront investment project near Canggu, the area is set to experience sustained development, driving long-term property appreciation. Denpasar Airport is within comfortable reach, ensuring effortless connectivity for international travelers.

For those seeking a residence that embodies coastal elegance, cultural authenticity, and exceptional investment potential, Seseh delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of pristine beaches, luxury amenities, and a prestigious address makes it one of Bali’s most desirable locations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of island living — serene, sophisticated and strategically positioned for long-term value.
